ائتلفن (form VIII)
# اِئْتَلَفْنَ (iʔtalafna) /iʔ.ta.laf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
# اِئْتَلِفْنَ (iʔtalifna) /iʔ.ta.lif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِئْتَلَفَ (iʔtalafa)
